artists.biography:
Gruffydd Maredudd Bowen Rhys (born 18 July 1970 in Haverfordwest) is a Welsh musician, performing solo and with several bands, including Super Furry Animals who obtained mainstream success in the 1990s. He also most recently formed the electro-pop outfit Neon Neon with Boom Bip. Their album Stainless Style was nominated for the 2008 Nationwide Mercury Prize. He won the 2011 Welsh Music Prize for his album Hotel Shampoo.
He was educated at Ysgol Dyffryn Ogwen, Bethesda, Gwynedd, North Wales and was awarded a degree in art at Manchester Metropolitan University.

perplexity.description:
Sadness Sets Me Free is the eighth studio album by Welsh musician Gruff Rhys, released on January 26, 2024, through Rough Trade Records. The album was recorded over three days in March 2022 at La Frette studio in Paris, capturing a spontaneous and intimate sound. Musically, it blends elements of rock and pop with an indie sensibility, characterized by a subdued, low-key style that contrasts with the emotional depth of the lyrics. The arrangements feature electric and acoustic guitars, synthesizers, piano, double bass, and strings, creating a textured yet restrained atmosphere.

Within Rhys's discography, Sadness Sets Me Free stands out for its introspective tone and minimalist production compared to some of his more lavish previous works. Critics praised the album for its subtlety and emotional resonance; Joe Muggs of The Arts Desk described it as "weird, inspiring and very lovely," while Nathan Whittle of Louder Than War highlighted the oxymoronic blend of darkness and hope in the songs. Commercially, the album performed well, reaching number 22 on the UK Albums Chart and number 7 on the Scottish Albums Chart, as well as number 5 on the UK Independent Albums Chart.

Overall, Sadness Sets Me Free is recognized as a thoughtful and carefully crafted addition to Gruff Rhys's body of work, balancing melancholic themes with melodic accessibility within the rock and pop genres.
